phasing_details.phase_detail: Installation of AHSP unit is complete. Installation of proposed compact louvred housing to take place within weeks of any grant of planning permission

waste_details.reason_for_no_provision: This is a small application for placing an outdoor Air con unit with Associated screening that doesn't generate any of these wastes.

subdivision_of_building:
Ground floor, front, shop.
The applicant leases the shop premises, part of a row of shops with residential units above and behind.
The application premises are single aspect, having a single frontage onto the street, incorporating the entry door and shop window. In separate ownership is a residential flat above with an entry door sited to the side of the application premises' window, that occupies the first floor and the part of the building that sits behind the shop.
description: Retention of Air Source Heat Pump (ASHP) with proposed compact louvred housing (revised scheme)
